prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D pixel-art street NPC sprite atlas for a cheerful Japanese gyaru driving game. Primary request: exactly six separate full-body ADULT street NPC sprites in a perfectly equal 3-column by 2-row grid, image 1536 by 1024 if possible. Each equal cell is 512 by 512. Each adult is a generic character, not either DJ heroine. Cohesive highly polished Japanese arcade pixel art with crisp dark outlines, coherent tiny square pixel clusters, 3-4 tones per material, expressive chibi heads and 3-head-tall adult bodies. Slight three-quarter SIDE VIEW facing right, readable at 40 by 75 displayed pixels. All feet at the same relative baseline in each cell, entire props contained, generous transparent gutters; no sprite touches cell boundary. Top left: tired but friendly male Japanese salaryman in charcoal-blue business suit, red tie, brown briefcase, black combed hair, walking. Top middle: same salaryman joyfully transformed into a glamorous blonde gyaru adult with big blonde curls, hot-pink jacket, white blouse, short black skirt with leggings, pink boots, confident hand raised in peace sign, glamorous playful makeup. Top right: cheerful curious adult fan in lavender hoodie, mint handbag, looking right with raised hand, small cream question speech bubble above head with only '?'. Bottom left: same salaryman in business suit holding an open transparent aqua umbrella over his head, shiny wet shoes. Bottom middle: same salaryman bundled in warm navy coat over suit, striped red scarf, cream knit beanie, winter boots. Bottom right: same salaryman wearing playful rally goggles pushed onto forehead, loosened tie, rolled sleeves, muddy tan boots and a few brown mud patches on business trousers. Lighting/mood: happy, playful, arcade collectible encounter. Color palette: navy outlines, warm skin, blonde gold, hot pink, lavender, mint and cyan accents. Constraints: exactly 6 characters and exactly 6 equal grid cells, true transparent alpha background, clean high-detail pixel sprites, consistent body sizes and perspective across six cells, no checkerboard, no scene, no ground, no shadows outside figures, no captions or logos, no violence, no vehicle, no extra characters. Precise pixel clusters, no blurry painted or photorealistic rendering.
notes: Six nominal 512px cells in a 3×2 atlas. Source silhouette crops are inspected and recorded in src/street-characters.js; the umbrella tip extends 16px above its nominal row. Alpha channel is preserved without post-processing. An atlas cleanup candidate was generated but not selected.
